key_notes: Key 1 (t=3.91s): Initial archival pose of cloud; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=5.04s): Mid-sequence articulation of cloud; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=6.27s): Peak dynamic extension of cloud over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=7.51s): Follow-through and settle of cloud with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of cloud (3.91s..7.51s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
